name: Set OLAP display folder
description: Set OLAP display folder of datamart transformation
statement:
/*
Set OLAP display folder of datamart transformation.
Parameters: 
	OnlyIfEmpty:	1 - only empty folders will be set, 0 - all folders will be set
	FolderName:		Name of the folder
	Schema_Name:	Name of the schema. If empty, all dimensions will be changed
*/
UPDATE C
SET C.OLAP_DisplayFolder = ':2'
FROM
	CFG.SCHEMAS S
	INNER JOIN CFG.TABLES T ON
		T.SchemaID = S.SchemaID AND
		T.TableTypeID IN (7, 8)
	INNER JOIN CFG.COLUMNS C ON
		C.TableID = T.TableID
WHERE
	S.SchemaTypeID = 5 AND
	(:3 IS NULL OR S.Schema_Name = :3) AND
	(:1 = 0 OR C.OLAP_DisplayFolder IS NULL OR C.OLAP_DisplayFolder = '')
